as_told.title: Kirkpatrick's AARO advisory group and contract work with Oak Ridge

plain: The story is that Sean Kirkpatrick, who led AARO, the Pentagon's current office for investigating unexplained aerial reports, went to work for Oak Ridge National Laboratory in Tennessee, a government science lab, after he left. A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell, who says he was close to it, explains that the contract for AARO's advisory group "was let through Oak Ridge," and that Kirkpatrick, once retired from government, now works "with and for Oak Ridge under contract." An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says Kirkpatrick "ran off to Oak Ridge" and tells listeners to look at Oak Ridge's ties to FFRDCs, privately run research centres paid for by the government. UAPGerb sums it up without naming a source, while McConnell speaks as someone who saw the arrangement. They tell it because, if these links mean what they suspect, the man in charge of the official UFO office was tied to the same private research world that critics say hides UFO material.
